provenance: Authored evaluation cases and catalogue-front assumptions; not external requirements or evidence of model quality.

cases.source: Record working time at electronic terminals only. No browser entry. Retain entries for 30 days, including entries with weak architecture scores. Keep the original paper consent note visible even without a taxonomy mapping.
Delete working-time entries after 30 days. Keep every working-time entry for at least 90 days. A supervisor must resolve this conflict; do not choose a retention period silently.

Acquire working-time events from terminals, validate incomplete pairs, calculate daily totals and publish a monthly statement. Corrections require an attributable history. A rejected correction must not modify the original event. Keep source timestamps on the published statement.

Provide a civilian observation service. The required notification channels, stale-data threshold, retention period and responsible reviewer are not yet decided. Do not invent values or treat the service as a safety-critical replacement for official warnings.
